description.zh:
实例规格名称，请参见[实例节点规格](~~194870~~)。
> InstanceType为空时，返回全部的实例规格列表。
description.en:
The instance specification name. For more information, see [Instance node specifications](~~194870~~).
> If InstanceType is left empty, all instance specifications are returned.

descriptions.zh:
完整的规格映射表以此接口的返回列表为标准。

返回异常报“instanceType is not found”错误， 则说明是弃用的规格，如强依赖此规格，可联系阿里云HBase管控团队。
descriptions.en:
The complete specification mapping table is based on the list returned by this operation.

If the response returns an "instanceType is not found" error, the specification has been deprecated. If you have a strong dependency on this specification, contact the Alibaba Cloud HBase management team.
